<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> can be obtained in multiple ways and is the basis of all written works. It can be crafted from [[pigskin paper]] at the [[church workbench]], which is itself easily made with [[skin]], or it can be made from [[paper glop]] in a paper press.  Additionally it can be purchased from the [[Astrologer]] on {{Day|sloth}}.  Paper is one of the items requested by [[Vagner]], the actor and is necessary to write [[flyer]]s for the [[Inquisitor]].  Paper is also very useful for converting into [[science]] for the purposes of performing research at the [[study table]].
